name: Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Ltd (SMIORE)
tagline: Karnataka's flagship manganese/iron-ore miner (3rd largest manganese miner in India) with strong 10-year growth and a conservative balance sheet - but the stock has already tripled over the past year, leaving little valuation margin for a fresh thesis.
business_overview: SMIORE (Sandur Group flagship, incorporated 1954) mines low-phosphorous manganese and iron ore in the Hosapete-Ballari region of Karnataka and manufactures ferro-alloys (silico-manganese, ferro manganese) and coke at its Vyasankere plant. It is India's 3rd largest manganese ore miner. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@sab_maya_hai__, bearish view, medium conviction, 2026-09-13) - note the seed signal itself was bearish, not bullish.
